traceability.notes:
All key aspects of Story 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION are implemented and verified: - Core Functionality: The valid-req-reference rule, together with valid-req-reference-helpers, parses @story/@req/@supports annotations, resolves the referenced story file, reads its content, extracts all REQ-... requirement IDs, and verifies that the annotated requirement IDs exist. Missing IDs produce a precise 'Requirement "" not found in ""' error. - Quality Standards: Requirement IDs are detected via a regex scan over the entire markdown file, independent of section names or structural formatting. Tests cover standard story files, bullet-list formatted requirements, and multi-story fixtures, demonstrating correct behavior across different story file structures and list formats. - Integration: The rule is registered in src/index.ts, enabled in recommended/strict configs alongside existing annotation and story validation rules, and operates on the same annotations those rules validate. It shares consistent path security semantics (path traversal and absolute path disallowed) with the file validation story. - User Experience: Error messages for missing requirements and invalid paths are concise, specific, and parameterized with both reqId and storyPath; tests assert exact messageId and data values, aligning with the error-reporting story. - Error Handling: Story files are read inside a try/catch; any I/O failure or malformed content results in an empty requirement set instead of throwing, so ESLint continues running and surfaces reqMissing diagnostics rather than crashing. Path traversal and absolute-path issues are explicitly reported as invalidPath errors. - Documentation: docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md documents the rule’s purpose, deep validation behavior, path protections, interplay of @story/@req and @supports, and includes concrete correct/incorrect examples. It explicitly references this story and its deep-validation requirements.
Given the concrete implementation, targeted tests tied to this story, supporting fixtures, and documentation, this story is fully implemented and behaves as specified.
